reasoning: Base ratings: the Suns are -0.8 and the Hornets -6.4 points per game against an average team; with home court that makes the Suns 18.5 better here, total 217.
Rest, travel and availability move it 1.4 towards the Hornets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: Suns by 17.2, 90% to win; total 217 (80% range 193-241).
